mainEntity.name: When should I start preparing my books for taxes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideally you keep them current all year. If not, start by November so you have time to chase missing documents.
Generally, for any contractor or vendor you paid $600 or more during the year. You need their W-9 first.

mainEntity.name: Should I pay quarterly estimated taxes?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you're self-employed and expect to owe $1,000+ at filing, usually yes. Confirm with your tax professional to avoid underpayment penalties.

mainEntity.name: What's the fastest way to lower my tax-prep bill?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hand your preparer reconciled, clean books. They charge for cleanup time — remove it.
